When you're learning a new language, you automatically also gain knowledge about a new culture. It's like peeping into a whole new world! That is my main motivation for learning a new language - together with of course getting new best friends from all around the world. And the motivation only grows stronger when you move to a country where you don't understand anything at all!

I always dive deep into the language that I'm learning. Every time I analyse some aspect of the new language, I find similarities to what I already know, and when I find these treasures, I can’t help to share them. pro_course_detail.title: Phrasal verbs for Intermediate English students
pro_course_detail.description: For students from the age of 8. In this lesson, we'll go through some commonly used phrasal verbs. Anaximander, Heraclitus, Parmenides, Plato, Plotinus, Pseudo-Dionysius, Meister Eckhart, Bruno, Pico della Mirandola, Spinoza, Berkeley, Hume, Kant, Hegel, Schelling, Nietzsche, Heidegger, Bataille, Blanchot, Deleuze & Guattari, Agamben, Negri & Hardt, Castoriadis, Nagarjuna, Candrakirti, Bhaviveka, Zhiyi, Dogen, Nishida, Nishitani ...

course_info.trial_description: To start, let's discuss what you need as a student and how I can meet your needs. I'll teach a short lesson to give you an understanding of my approach to teaching. After the reading, you'll answer questions to improve your comprehension of the text and we'll discuss points from the texts. I'll also provide practice exercises such as gap fills and definition matching. As I get to know you, I'll develop lessons that focus on topics that are interesting to you which keeps the conversations between us more comfortable and natural. This will also help you to gradually improve your fluency. You'll learn English idioms and expressions that are commonly used in speaking such as 'Let's catch up!' I look forward to catching up with you each time we have a lesson. :)

teacher_info.about_teacher: I have a very student-driven teaching style. That means you can let me know if you prefer conversational practice or need help preparing for a language exam. I want you to feel comfortable during our lessons, so I provide my students with the resources and support they need. I have a lot of patience, so don’t worry if you are a beginner. I will help you take your language skills to the next level.
teacher_info.teaching_style: During our first lesson, I want to discuss your goals and see what level you are currently at. That helps me get an idea of what you expect from our lessons and how I can help you improve. I can prepare guided lessons if that makes my students feel more comfortable, but I‘m also happy just to have simple conversations (that helped me a lot to improve my French). After each lesson, I can give you an article to read, a video to watch or a podcast to listen to, so we have a subject to discuss in our next lesson. We can also go through mock exams or exercises to improve your grammar and vocabulary.

course_info.trial_description: In our trial lesson we will discuss what your goals are and we will see what I can do to help you reach those.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Practice. Let‘s talk! German
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to practise your German skills? Let's get started, we can talk about anything from A ( Antarctica) to Z( Zebra) with a coffee or tea while having a nice chat. Whether you are struggling with small talk, or you‘d like to indulge in deeper intellectual debate, let‘s find some topics of mutual interest to discuss and start talking. I‘m a very patient listener and I‘ll encourage you to talk and correct you when necessary. We can also talk about ways to help you improve your confidence and review any areas for potential development of your language skills.
I look forward to meeting you :)

pro_course_detail.title: German with a book/Grammar, Vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description: Especially for students who need to practice their grammar are just starting out or prefer learning with the help of a book should book this class. We will use the book 'Menschen' and additional material. At the end of every lesson, you will receive your vocabulary list and new grammar which we will practice together. You will learn new words and practice them with me. We are also using Google Docs to write down the mistakes you are making but also we will write down new words that we are learning during our lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: A1 total beginners
pro_course_detail.description: You are just starting out? This lesson focuses on giving you a basic understanding of the German language. You will have to do some homework which we will discuss. You will also have to spend some time studying the new vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: English for kids
pro_course_detail.description: This lesson is best suitable for kids who want to learn English. In this lesson, I will introduce students to the basics of the English language. We will look at phonics and phonetics, numbers, the alphabet and so much more. I will provide structured lessons and give students homework and customized lesson plans for each student.
